title: Public-office and justice-system accountability scope
covered_roles: district attorneys and prosecution staff acting in public roles
public defenders and appointed public-defense offices
other local public officials when an official oversight record is in scope
source_priority: official appointing/employing agency roster or government directory
official inspector general, auditor, commission, or government report
minimum_fields_for_person_specific_recor: neutral official outcome when one exists
publication_rules: Use titles and role-relevant identifying information only to the degree needed to distinguish public officials in official records.
Do not use scores or reputational labels.
Show source date and procedural status prominently.
Link to the primary official record whenever feasible.
Allow corrections, updates, supersession, and appeal-status changes through a dated record history.
not_a_scorecard: This collection is a source index and accountability record, not a rating system. It does not make character, fitness, guilt, or competence conclusions about identifiable people.
